description: If a shared state byte is neither zero nor four, the routine resets it and clears bit 0 of a byte at offset 5 through a helper call. It then clears bit 7 of the byte at offset 8 and writes the value 28 to offsets 9, 10 and 54 of a structure.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:213E

description: This routine sets the lowest bit of a byte at offset 5 of a structure, calls two helpers, then enters an endless loop with no exit.

description: Below an index of 32 this routine stores four constants into shared variables, conditionally calls helpers, copies a block of six 32-bit values to a destination, and then loops forever toggling a flag with timed waits. Otherwise it compares a shared byte with a stored value and, if they differ, updates that value and calls helpers.

name: call_two_helpers_then_halt
description: This routine calls two helper routines and then enters an endless loop with no exit. It has no other logic.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2396

description: This routine replaces the byte at offset 13 of one structure with that byte multiplied by five, copies a 16-bit field at offset 14 into a second structure, and clears bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5. It makes no calls of its own besides helper calls at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:23F6
name: search_three_byte_table
description: This routine scans a table of three-byte records for an entry whose third byte equals the value in a data register. It stops at a record whose first byte equals minus one, which marks the end of the table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2414
name: store_index_and_advance_counter
description: This routine calls a helper, writes the value 254 to a field of a structure, and stores a byte from a data register in a table slot chosen by a shared counter. It then sets a second shared byte to zero or to the counter minus six, and increments the counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2442
name: remove_table_entry_by_value
description: This routine calls a helper, then searches a byte table for a value in a data register. When it finds the value, it shifts the later entries down by one, decrements a shared counter, and resets a related byte depending on whether the counter is below nine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2488
name: call_helper_then_scale_byte
description: This routine calls one helper routine, then replaces the byte at offset 13 of one structure with that byte multiplied by five. It copies a 16-bit field at offset 14 into a second structure and clears bit zero of a flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2490
name: clear_flag_bits_and_call
description: This routine clears bit four of a shared state variable and bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 of a structure, then calls a helper routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24AC
name: reset_entry_and_write_codes
description: This routine clears bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 and zeroes the byte at offset 13 of one structure. It then calls a helper, writes the value 65 to offset 3 of a second structure, calls a helper again, and writes 66 to that same offset.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24B0
name: clear_flag_and_write_codes
description: This routine clears bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 and zeroes the byte at offset 13 of one structure. It then calls a helper, writes the value 65 to offset 3 of a second structure, calls a helper again, and writes 66 there.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2504

description: This routine checks a four-byte tag at the start of a data block and reads the width, depth and row count from its header. It allocates memory through a library call, fills a 256-byte lookup table, and then programs the custom chip blitter registers for each block of rows.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2524

description: This routine toggles a flag and, when a limit from a data register falls below a computed row count, programs the custom chip blitter with mask words and a row stride. key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2550

description: This routine fills a sequence of structures with the constants 10, 160 and 4, copies two pointer-sized globals, and runs nested loops that wait on counters. Each wait loop is a polling check on a value that changes outside the routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:26E2

description: This routine stores a value from its input register, conditionally calls helpers, and copies a block of six 32-bit values to a destination. It then loops forever toggling a flag and calling helpers, with a timed wait on each pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28BE

description: This routine calls the Amiga exec free-memory function repeatedly through a stored library pointer, decrementing a counter until it reaches minus one. Each call releases one memory block.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28DE
name: convert_planar_bits_to_bytes
description: This routine stores two library call results in shared variables, then converts bits from four source bitplanes into bytes by looking up a 16-entry pattern table. It writes the results to three output buffers, advancing through each row.

description: This is an alternate entry into the same planar-to-byte conversion loop, with an identical body. It reads four bitplanes and writes lookup results to three output buffers.

description: This is a handler-table entry into the same planar-to-byte conversion loop, with an identical listing. It reads four bitplanes and writes lookup results to three output buffers.

description: This is another handler-table entry into the same planar-to-byte conversion loop, with an identical listing. It reads four bitplanes and writes lookup results to three output buffers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:28F2

description: The facts record a call to the Amiga exec memory allocation function, and the listing shows the same planar-to-byte conversion loop as its neighbours. The routine stores allocation results and then converts four bitplanes into byte buffers through a lookup table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2978

description: This routine builds a 16-entry lookup table by computing a value from each of sixteen source words. It then repeatedly picks the largest remaining value, stores its index in the table, and marks that slot as used.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:29EC
name: threshold_adjust_pixels_to_planes
description: This routine walks rows of pixel bytes, comparing each against a neighbouring byte and a threshold, and adjusts pixel values by a small step. It then sets or clears one bit in each of four bitplane words from a lookup table.

description: This routine calls one helper and then sets a shared flag variable to zero. It has no other logic.

name: call_helper_then_zero_flag
description: This routine calls one helper and then sets a shared flag variable to zero. It has no other logic.

name: run_timed_handshake_sequence
description: This routine clears bit zero of a flag byte, sets a shared state to one, and calls helpers while polling counters and flags in loops. When the state ends at zero it sets bit zero of the flag byte and records a new state of two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2AC2

description: This routine sets a shared state to one, calls helpers, and polls counters and flags in loops until the state returns to zero. When the state ends at zero it sets bit zero of a flag byte and records a new state of two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2B32

description: This routine calls one helper, writes the character N to offset zero of a buffer, and writes L or D to offset three depending on whether a shared value equals one.

description: This routine clears a shared flag and calls helpers. It returns early when a shared 16-bit value is nonzero, otherwise it toggles a shared bit, copies one value to another, and loops forever.

description: This routine calls one helper and then enters an endless loop with no exit.

name: clear_flag_bit_four_entries
description: This routine loops four times over a table of pointers from a shared address, clearing bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 in each structure. It then zeroes two shared values.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2C98
name: copy_two_fields_to_slots
description: This routine copies two 16-bit fields at offsets 14 and 16 of a structure into two fixed memory slots, then assigns a shared variable to itself.

description: This routine calls helpers, compares a four-character tag at an address with a fixed tag, and replaces it with another fixed tag when they match. It then writes a single character at offset 3 and copies a value into a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2CF6

description: This routine clears a shared value and makes three helper calls. It then clears bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 and zeroes the byte at offset 13 of a structure.

description: This routine runs two passes, and on each pass it calls helpers and toggles a shared bit.

description: This routine compares a four-character tag at an address with fixed tag values. When the tag matches one of them it calls helpers, otherwise it resets a shared state and runs a polled wait loop before setting a shared byte to 70.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2E0C

description: This routine calls two helpers and writes the character C to offset three of a buffer. It then resets a shared state, runs a polled wait loop, sets a shared byte to 70, and clears the state.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2E50
name: add_fifty_to_field_branch
description: This routine clears a shared state, makes helper calls, and adds 50 to a 16-bit field at offset 38 of a structure. It then makes one of two sets of helper calls depending on whether a shared value equals minus two.

name: initialise_slot_values_and_state
description: This routine clears a shared state, makes helper calls, and sets a shared byte to 15. It then writes the values 200 and 250 into two fixed memory slots and clears the shared state again.

description: This routine checks a four-byte tag at the start of a data block, reads the width and row count from the header, and allocates memory through a library call. It then fills a 256-byte table and stores the results in shared variables.

description: This routine uses the same header check and table setup as the nearby bitmap loader. It stores its allocated block and results in a second set of shared variables.

description: This routine calls two helper routines, then toggles a shared bit and returns.

name: copy_word_field_to_target
description: This routine calls a helper, then copies the 16-bit field at offset 38 of a shared structure into the same offset of a structure whose pointer is in an address register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:30A8
name: process_six_fifteen_byte_records
description: This routine calls helpers, then runs a loop six times, calling a helper with the loop counter and a pointer that advances 15 bytes on each pass. It finishes by calling helpers and setting a shared byte to 70.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:310C
name: clear_state_and_call_helpers
description: This routine clears a shared state variable and makes four helper calls, one of which is a small subtraction routine. It then returns.

description: This routine clears a shared state variable and clears bit zero of a flag byte at offset 5 of a structure. It then makes six helper calls and sets a shared byte to 103.

name: reset_state_and_set_code
description: This routine clears a shared state variable, calls six helpers, and sets a shared byte to 103.

description: This routine maps an input key code to a numeric action code by checking specific key values against the current shared state, and returns that code. For one key value it runs a short wait loop before returning.

name: dispatch_key_code_to_handlers
description: This routine handles an input key code according to the current shared state, updating state variables and calling helper routines for each recognised code. Some branches run polled wait loops, and the routine returns after handling the code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:393E
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The decompiled body contains only a return, although the routine has 65 instructions and calls 15 routines. The listing is incomplete, so no behaviour can be recovered from it.

name: lookup_three_stride_value
description: This routine reads a byte from a table at a fixed address, indexed by three times a data register value, and stores it in a shared 16-bit location.

description: This routine reads a byte from the same three-stride table, indexed by three times a data register value, and returns it as a 16-bit value.

description: This large dispatcher branches on a command byte and a secondary parameter, with many state transitions that update shared variables and call helpers. Some branches return a value, and others run polled loops.

name: return_shared_byte_times_seven
description: This routine returns a shared byte multiplied by seven, with no other logic.

description: This routine copies six shared bytes to a destination, then copies two-byte table pairs until a minus-one marker. It then copies sixteen shared words and several structure fields into the same buffer.

description: This routine returns one without restoring when a source flag is zero and a shared value is nonzero. Otherwise it copies the saved table pairs and words back into shared memory, sets one field to 150, and returns zero.

name: save_table_words_to_buffer
description: This routine copies two-byte table pairs into a buffer until a minus-one marker, then copies sixteen shared words and several structure fields after them.

description: This routine copies bytes from a source to a destination, advancing the source by a per-row stride times a width value. It stops when the control table reads 255.

name: copy_strided_rows_reverse
description: This routine performs the same strided copy in the opposite direction, writing into the source buffer until the control table reads 255.

description: This routine clears bit zero of a flag byte when a shared value is zero. For each of four table entries whose shared flag is zero, it zeroes offset 13 and toggles the bytes at offsets 9, 10 and 54.

description: This routine writes the two low decimal digits of a value through an address register, moving backwards, and then writes the character R as a terminator.

description: This large state machine reads the custom chip vertical-position register, which tracks the video raster, and updates shared state and structure fields based on two stored codes. It calls helper routines and copies tables as it goes.

description: This routine sets a flag and sets a 16-bit field at offset 38 to 830. It then loops over a table of pointers, clearing each nonzero entry and calling a helper for it, until the list ends or its count runs out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:56D2

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:571A

description: This routine reads a 32-bit shared value, writes the same value back, and returns the register pair, with no other logic.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:591E

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:5C72

description: This routine copies a 16-bit register value into a shared word and returns.

description: This routine copies sixteen 16-bit words from shared memory to the address held in a code pointer, advancing two bytes per word.

description: This routine copies sixteen 16-bit words from a source address into shared memory at every second word slot.

description: This routine converts directional key codes, including their high-bit variants, into a step of minus one or plus one for a 16-bit register value. It returns the adjusted value, and non-directional keys leave it unchanged.
